answer: Audits are recorded in gale, queued in terrace, and relic publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 74 identities per epoch. A farm of 109 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 2118 identities would post 3914 proofs and burn roughly 23 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
